notes.title: Update V 1.05.a
notes.content:
Major Update | Open World Test Part 2!
-Foliage performance check.

Minor Updates
1. Main Menu Interactions
-Main Menu is now interactable with grips and trigger presses.
2. Character Skin
-Character Skin has been changed from Subsurface Profile to Default Lit.

Update Summary
+Major Summary
-The open world is almost complete and meeting performance specs! Currently testing foliage performance from Steam. Next patch aims to add playable content to the open world expansion!

+Minor Summary
-Making the Main Menu more user friendly for people who prefer trigger interactions.
-Subsurface Profile shading has been causing rendering issues AND it takes up about 10% of my Graphical Performance Budget. I will explore other shading options for skin in future character appearance updates, but for now using Default Lit shaders solves the rendering problem and saves performance.

Dev Note
Thank you Taylor for the feedback! Trigger interactions always bugged me, but as the VR standard I should be more inclusive, especially at the Main Menu. In future updates I will add adjustable button mappings, and alternate Player UI options for Wrist Mounted UI and Stationary UI. It is officially on my list!

While working on this next patch I am going to be putting more effort into marketing and community outreach. Multiplayer games are more fun and exciting when there are multiple players! Coding more content and progressing the game is important but so is building a player base.

notes.title: Update V 1.05
notes.content:
Major Update | Added Open World Test Level!

Minor Updates
1. Bug Fixes
-Fixed the bug causing double failure quips to play after failing a quest. It was too annoying for me to leave unaddressed until the guild quest rework!

Open World Notes
Test map can be accessed via the preference settings page in the player ui. It is mostly empty except for a couple test assets. This patch is just to confirm the performance specs on Steam meet test specs in Editor testing. If it does meet specs, I'll start modeling or sourcing foliage assets and content to fill the world. If it doesn't meet specs, I'll find a solution and retest.

Note that there are new game textures, and I have added both player character mesh to the level to test subsurface shaders so the initial load may lag while new shaders are compiled, but otherwise it should be fast and smooth.
Expect minor delays, I'll probably be moving between now and next patch, but will continue dev work nonstop.
*****
I was going to make a map as large as Breath Of The Wild but opted to make a smaller map for several reasons. The goal is to make a fun open world game map. I felt that in this case bigger wasn't better. When you traverse a massive map in most mmos players afk walk. I don't want to force players to walk miles between points of interest in VR. That would be bad design. It's also important to maintain buttery smooth frame rates. Large maps aren't free, and I can make better levels with more content packed into smaller areas. Lastly, it would suck for me to make an 80km2 map and need to scrap it for a smaller map.

I prototyped several massive maps from 1km2 to 100km2. I felt that 36km2 was a good balance for my current level plan with 5 towns and 6 biomes. For reference it's a little smaller than Skyrim's map which is still massive and may need to be pulled back further.

Teaser: I can look to make an expansion with an even bigger map in the future, but I'll probably need some good in game mounts before making a bigger map.

Rip the test grass. It was beautiful in PC testing, but VR didn't appreciate the added 10 million triangle count.

notes.title: Update V 1.04
notes.content:
Major Update | Added Guild Spatial Storage!

Minor Updates
1. Bug Fixes
-Koomkoom fur rendering with a ghostly white glow in headsets right lens. Presumably a result of the combination of Subsurface material shader using Screenspace information to fake subsurface scattering effects and Instanced Stereo Rendering sharing Screenspace information to reduce the render thread to a single execution across both eyes. Documentation is very limited. Currently replacing Koomkoom Fur material with a Default Lit shading version to avoid the ghostly glow. The result is similar, but the skin pores are assentuated and the appearance is roughed comparatively. Unless you are giving the Koomkoom an ear exam you won't notice. I will look to correct other "ghostly" materials as reported and look into better skin solutions to maintain softer character skins if possible. The issue could be corrected by disabling Instanced Stereo Rendering, but it can not be done at runtime, would effect game performance, and require me to recompile every shader in the game. I'll continue to monitor the situation and look for the most optimal solution.

-Fixed a bug causing Global Settings Data to not save between sessions.

notes.title: Update V 1.03
notes.content:
Major Update | Released Koomkoom!

Minor Updates
1. Bug Fixes
-Invincible Gemstone Wasps O_o. Wasps that had magic were also immune to damage. All Gemstone Wasps now correctly receive damage.
-Advent Sword+ Damage plane Z axis was 100X to large. Nerfed extent from 90.07 to 0.9007.
-Fixed a bug where item descriptions don't wrap the text in the shop pages.
2. Balance Updates
Ferroaluminium unit cost buff 3 > 2.

notes.title: Update V 1.02
notes.content:
Major Update | Released Crimson Demon Firefly!

Minor Updates
1. Added New Light Metal
-Added Ferroaluminium as a low tier light metal. This should make great swords a little more friendly in the early game if you are willing to pay a slightly higher price for the alloyed metal.
2. Balance Updates
*Armadillidiidae Buff
-Curled damage reduction  50% > 70%
-Base health  50 > 100
*Basilisk Buff
-Base health  500 > 1000
*Gemstone Wasp Buff low / Nerf high
-Flat base health mult  1.0 > 1.25
-Iri base health mult 4.0 > 3.0
-Note. Vanta black, a rare varient was not nerfed and has a base health mult of 4.5 and can grow to be 20% larger than Iri. It is very very rare in early dungeons but may also need a nerf in future patches. 
3. Bug Fixes
-Dungeon spawn offset for player 30 > 35.
-Dungeon spawn offset for AI 35 > 40.

Shoutout
1. Thanks, Alex, for saying great swords were heavy! Ferroaluminium unlocked!
2. Thanks, Cykamourn, for balancing feedback! Here's a swarm mob for you to play with, I'll surround you with Wasps soon and keep adding fun new things as I build out this virtual world!

notes.title: Update V 1.01
notes.content:
Major Update | Released Gemstone Wasp

Minor Updates
New Features
1. Added Sprint Ability
2. Added Aim Assist for magic
3. Added Developer Tips to Main Menu

Improvements
4. Updated wording for
-Forge Purchasing (Material Cost # > Cost # G)
-Kana Sphere Description (Mana Red # x > Mana Red # %)
-Online Gate message (Close Online Session > Disband Party to Close Online Session)
5. Bestiary Update (Buffed descriptions to include combat tips, stats, and icon)
6. Buffed Collection Quest Rewards
7. Buffed Spell SFX audio levels
8. Buffed Sword durability X 4
9. Nerfed Armadillidiidae base health by 95% and curled damage reduction by 28.6%... My bad on that
10. Preemptively nerfed Basilisk base health by 90%. I can buff it later, better to err on the side of the player than to make something unkillable and unfun.

Bug Fixes
11. Forge Armor Type page switching from Light to Heavy now works as intended
12. Arcanum Cast Response (correctly handles grip interactions when opening new levels)
13. TEMP user interface button from dev testing repurposed to Reset Player Z Location +100 units 
14. Stuck in floor (increased dungeon relocation offset for players and mobs)
15. Disband Party game crashes have been resolved

Shoutout
Huge shoutout to Cykamourn (1-15) and Alex (1, 2, 14). None of the minor updates were planned for 1.01 but were added because of direct feedback. I'm too deep to catch all the little things that help make the game shine but am more than happy to polish them when someone points them out to me! If you have any suggestions, I will look into them. I am an awesome dev, and I value community feedback seriously.
